title: Auto-update can rebuild the cache mid-work
source: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-caching (an upgrade means a cold cache on the first turn; DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 controls when upgrades apply); https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars

fix.text: Set DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER=1 and update on your own schedule; a version change invalidates the prompt cache.
